meeting_scene: As the team gathered around the conference table, Jordan stood up to lead the meeting, his usual enthusiasm infectious. "Hey everyone, great to see you all here," he said with a warm smile, and Priya nodded in agreement, her eyes scanning the room as she took out her notebook. Alex, who had been quietly observing from their seat near the window, suddenly spoke up, "I think we've made great progress on the Smith account, but I'm still waiting to hear back from marketing about the deadline." Jordan nodded thoughtfully and replied, "Actually, Priya was just checking in with marketing this morning, and they confirmed that our revised proposal is due by the end of the week. With everyone's hard work, I'm confident we'll meet that deadline."
